newsitem.title: FRANCE: French cable cos win right to supply Net access.
newsitem.headline: French cable cos win right to supply Net access.

text.p: ART, the French telecommunications regulator, said telephone operator France Telecom must allow cable television companies to supply Internet connection on cable networks they operate which are owned by France Telecom.

In a statement issued Friday, ART also said it set the price cable television operators should pay telephone operator France Telecom for Internet connection at about three francs a year for each Net connection fitted.

The price would bring France Telecom some 4.5 million francs for the Paris cable network, operated by Lyonnaise Cable, a subsidiary of Suez-Lyonnaise des Eaux, and a similar amount for the 18 networks operated by Compagnie Generale des Eaux's cable TV unit, Compagnie Generale de Videocommunication (CGV).

"The decisions taken by ART will allow about three million French households, or nearly half of the 6.7 (cable) connections installed in homes, schools and enterprises, to connect to the Internet via a high capacity line," ART said.

It ruled that the two cable operators, which complained to ART in April, must finance the installation and maintenance of specific equipment for Internet access, and would be the owners of this equipment.
France Telecom would be responsible for carrying out work neccessary on its cable networks to bring them up to standard for supplying Internet connection.
The two cable operators would bear the full cost of this work, ART said.
They would also be responsible for maintenance on the network, a cost which ART set provisionally at five percent of the cost of bringing the network up to scratch.
ART also said the conditions it set needed to be put in place quickly, and stipulated that contracts for the work should be signed by September 30.
Lyonnaise Cable complained to ART on April 1 and CGV on April 18, saying that France Telecom was asking too high a price for Internet access on cable networks.
France Telecom owns two-thirds of the cable television networks in France, and rents two-thirds of those networks to Lyonnaise Cable and CGV.
ART said its decisions covered only Internet access via cable networks and were not applicable to supplying telephone services on cable networks. MH/SLA
